The function should return "Yes" if station Z is on the path between X and Y, and "No" otherwise.

1. If X < Y (inbound travel), check if X < Z < Y.
2. If X > Y (outbound travel), check if Y < Z < X.
3. Correct the input types to integers, as the logic requires numerical comparisons.
4. Remove the unused parameter N from the function signature and logic.
